{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Great Eagle Bow Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Great Eagle Bow Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Great Eagle Bow Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Great Eagle Bow Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 28 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 60 }} |comp= {{List| * [[Falcon Bow]] * [[Swallow Bow]] }} |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Great Eagle Bow|Great Eagle Bows|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 28 |durability = 60 |multishot = 3 |multishot_angle = 3 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Great Eagle Bow}} Great Eagle Bows are [[Bow]]s belonging to the [[Rito Gear]] equipment archetype. They are powerful Bows for aerial combat that can fire three [[Arrow]]s at once, similar to the [[Lynel Bow]] and its counterparts. {{Frameless|[[File:BotW Revali Artwork.png|thumb|left|200px|alt= Artwork of Revali holding his Great Eagle Bow.|Revali with a Great Eagle Bow]]}} Prior to the [[Great Calamity]], the [[Rito]] [[Champion]] [[Revali]] wielded a Great Eagle Bow. During the [[EX Recovered Memory]]" [[Champion Revali's Song (Memory)|Champion Revali's Song]]", the Bow is missing the blue cloth resembling [[Revali's Champion Garb]]. In this Memory, Revali can be seen practicing shooting [[Target]]s with his Great Eagle Bow at the [[Flight Range]]. It is said that Revali could fire [[Arrow]]s from his Bow with the speed of a gale, making him adept at aerial combat. [[Teba]] claims that they too heavy for the average Rito to wield, as they would end up losing all their speed. However, he states that Revali's strength and speed allowed him to counter the detriments of the [[Weapon]]. [[Kaneli]] will gift [[Link]] Revali's Great Eagle Bow in [[Rito Village]] as a reward for calming [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]]. This is done at the suggestion of Teba, who was impressed by how Link handled his own Bow against the [[Divine Beast]]. It can be retrieved from inside a [[Stone Chest]] in [[Kaneli's House]]. If Link's Great Eagle Bow breaks or becomes irreversibly lost, [[Harth]] can make a new one for him if he provides a [[Swallow Bow]], five bundles of [[Wood]], and a [[Diamond]]. If it was dropped somewhere but can still be re-obtained, Harth will instead recommend trying to find it first, as it is expensive to make. Being made of wood, Great Eagle Bows will burn if they touch [[Fire]] or are equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. Finally, Great Eagle Bows cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_028" |Life = 60 |Power = 28 |Range = 40.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 13 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 10 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 20 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 14 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 23 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 21 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 50 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = true |LeadShotNum = 3 |LeadShotAng = 3.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.8 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Great Eagle Bow}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 28×3 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} Great Eagle Bows reappear in {{TotK}}. {{Frameless|[[File:TotK Tulin Artwork 3.png|thumb|right|200px|alt= Artwork of Tulin carrying his Great Eagle Bow.|Tulin with a Great Eagle Bow]]}} By tradition, [[Revali]]'s Great Eagle Bow is bestowed to the best warrior among the [[Rito]]. Initially, [[Teba]] is in possession of this Great Eagle Bow, as evidenced by the blue cloth tied around its limb. According to [[Tulin]], having this [[Bow]] means a lot to Teba. At the end of the [[Main Quest]] "[[Tulin of Rito Village]]", Teba passes his Bow down to Tulin, acknowledging that he has proven himself as a warrior. From this point on, Tulin will wield this Great Eagle Bow in place of his [[Swallow Bow]], and he expresses a desire to keep it in prime condition. His [[Sage Avatar]] will also carry a projection of a Great Eagle Bow, which Link is able to take a [[Picture]] of for the [[Hyrule Compendium]]. During the [[War in the Depths of Hyrule]], Tulin appears and fights with his Bow if Link has awakened him as a [[Sage]]. After giving his Great Eagle Bow away, Teba expresses a desire to craft a new one for himself. He offers to make one for Link as well, though he requires a Swallow Bow, five bundles of [[Wood]], and three [[Diamond]]s from him. This starts the [[Side Quest]] "[[Legacy of the Rito]]". Upon receiving the proper supplies, Teba will proceed to make new Bows for himself and Link, claiming that the [[Harth]], the Rito's best craftsman, vouches for his skill. When he is finished, he will give Link his own Great Eagle Bow, telling him to use it in health. He also offers to make a replacement Bow should Link's be broken or lost. However, he will not do so if Link's Bow is still retrievable. Teba and Link's new Bows do not have the same blue cloth wrapped around it that Tulin's does. Following this, Teba will take pride in the fact that he and Tulin are using the same type of Bow. Tulin will also comment on Link's Great Eagle Bow if he equips it will speaking to him. During flashbacks to the [[Era of Foundation]]'s [[Imprisoning War]], the [[Sage of Wind]] [[Raphica]] can be seen wielding a Great Eagle Bow. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Revali Weapon }} Great Eagle Bows are a type of [[Weapon]] used by [[Revali]]. He is able to wield one when he is chosen as a [[Warrior]] for [[Scenario]]s and [[Challenge]]s. After he is officially appointed as a [[Champion]] following "[[The Road Home, Besieged]]", a blue cloth will be tied around Revali's Great Eagle Bow. A Great Eagle Bow is Revali's default Weapon that he uses in [[Movie]]s and [[Narration]]s. For example, he uses his Great Eagle Bow against [[Link]] during "[[Peacemaker]]", aims it at ambushing [[Monster]]s in "[[A Song from the Past]]", fights with it against [[Windblight Ganon]] in "[[Rescue Across Time: Air and Lightning]]", and uses it to shoot arrows at [[Guardian Skywatcher]]s threatening [[Teba]] during "[[Vah Medoh's Pilots]]". {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} [[Raphica]] can be seen wielding a Great Eagle Bow. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:TLoZ Revali amiibo.png|Revali amiibo with a Great Eagle Bow File:BotW Great Eagle Bow.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Revali using his Great Eagle Bow in the "Champion Revali's Song" Recovered Memory File:BotW Great Eagle Bow Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of the Great Eagle Bow File:TotK Teba Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}Artwork of Teba with his Great Eagle Bow File:AoC Revali Artwork 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Revali with his Great Eagle Bow File:AoC Great Eagle Bow Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for a Great Eagle Bow File:AoC Great Eagle Bow Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for a Great Eagle Bow File:AoC Revali Tapestry Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of Revali with a Great Eagle Bow File:AoI Raphica Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoI|-}}}}Artwork of Raphica wielding a Great Eagle Bow ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bow * Falcon Bow * Rito Gear * Swallow Bow }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Great Eagle Bow}}
